items.title: Rinvoq secures FDA nod in vitiligo, portending market showdown with Incyte
items.summary: AbbVie's immunology blockbuster Rinvoq secured an FDA nod in nonsegmental vitiligo, making it the first oral therapy approved for the condition and the first new targeted treatment to contend with Incyte's established therapy Opzelura.

items.title: Marksans Pharma flagged for 6 observations in wake of FDA inspection
items.summary: Indian drugmaker Marksans Pharma was cited over six observations in a Form 483 from the FDA.

items.title: Bristol Myers looks within for new CFO as David Elkins plots pivot to Coca-Cola
items.summary: Following some seven years as Bristol Myers Squibb’s chief financial officer, plus many more before that in the life sciences industry more broadly, David Elkins is trading the allure of Big Pharma for just about the biggest name there is in the world of refreshment.
